description: AI is a tool. It can be a benefit but it will never be a replacement for human interaction or the need for humans in jobs. Keith favors limited, responsible regulation of AI. AI doesn’t belong in schools or replacing medical professionals. You should always know when you’re interacting with AI rather than a human
